title: Abandoned House Part 1: The Outside 😱
caption: Part 1 of turning one abandoned house into a luxury home 🏚️➡️✨ Rate this house makeover from 1 to 10 👇
narration: This house was forgotten for years. First they pressure-washed years of grime off the walls. Then they gave the walls a fresh new finish, and rolled out fresh green grass. Honestly, this one turned out amazing. A new makeover every day... In part 2, you choose the next room. Follow so you don't miss it. And it all started... right here.
